summary: Reproduced the reported 'stuck on quiz pytanie 1/10, cannot click anything' bug via real Playwright browser automation for BOTH a brand-new regular user and the ADMIN account (admin@reset.app / Test@123). In both cases the quiz step-1 screen (3 tappable mode cards: quiz-mode-search/industry/life) worked EXACTLY as designed: tapping a card visually selects it (red border, background tint, radio-button-on icon), enables the previously-disabled 'Dalej' (Next) button, and tapping Next successfully advances to step 2 ('Co robisz obecnie?'). No console errors, no network failures, no red screen. Confirmed via API that admin's has_profile=false (same as new users), so admin is correctly redirected to /quiz by index.tsx logic. Confirmed by design: no back/cancel button shows on step 1 (since there's no navigation history and step>0 is false) -- this is intentional to force onboarding completion, not a bug.
action_items: No code fix required for this specific bug report -- could not reproduce 'cannot click anything/cannot proceed/cannot cancel' via real browser automation for either new users or admin.

Root cause of user's perceived issue is almost certainly UX-expectation mismatch, not a functional bug: (1) the Next button is disabled (visually lighter/faded pink) until one of the 3 required cards is tapped -- a first-time user may not register this as an active CTA since it looks similar enabled vs disabled at a glance on some devices/zoom levels, and (2) there is intentionally NO back/cancel/skip button on step 1 of the quiz (by design, to force onboarding) which can feel like being 'trapped' especially for an admin who may expect to skip the quiz entirely.

Suggested improvement (optional, not a bug fix): consider adding a more obvious disabled-state style difference for quiz-next-button (e.g. visibly greyed out vs just a lighter shade of brand color) so users clearly understand they must select an option first. Also consider an 'X' close/skip affordance for admin accounts specifically, since admins arguably don't need onboarding profile data to use the app meaningfully.

Verify on the actual reporting user's device/browser/network if this was perhaps a transient Metro bundler reload issue, slow network causing an unresponsive but not-yet-rendered Next button, or a one-off session glitch -- not reproducible in current build via automation.
critical_code_review_comments: quiz.tsx logic is sound: canNext correctly computed from current.groups.every(required fields filled), back() correctly handles step>0 vs router.canGoBack(), both verified working in live test.
No admin-specific special-casing in quiz.tsx/index.tsx -- admin goes through identical code path as regular users, confirmed identical behavior in both test runs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (quiz tap/select/advance flow verified for both new user and admin)

rca_of_issue: No root cause found -- feature works as designed. Most likely explanation for user's confusion: Next button is disabled until a card is selected (expected), and there's no back/cancel button on quiz step 1 (expected, by design to force onboarding). This is standard onboarding UX, not a bug. Suggest main agent treat this as closed/non-reproducible unless more specific repro details (device, browser, screen recording) are provided by the end user.
